name: Leibstadt Nuclear Power Plant
notes: Created by the cevns workstream (ID_REGISTRY Wave 3) as the current host facility of CONUS+ (the CONUS experiment's setup, relocated from facility:brokdorf-nuclear-power-plant in 2023).

Reactor thermal power (3.6 GWth, per arXiv:2407.11912) is not recorded as a `specs` quantity: the only Appendix A power-dimension spec key is `beam_power`, whose A21 plausibility range (1 kW-10 MW) is built for accelerator beamlines and rejects a gigawatt-scale reactor core; the figure is given in prose in `summary.technical` instead.

operator.note: Operator name not independently confirmed against a primary/official source in this pass.

summary.plain: A Swiss nuclear power plant on the Rhine that has hosted the CONUS+ reactor-neutrino experiment since late 2023.
summary.technical: Leibstadt Nuclear Power Plant (KKL), canton of Aargau, Switzerland; 3.6 GWth boiling water reactor (1285 MWe nameplate); hosts CONUS+ (the relocated CONUS experiment) 20.7 m from the reactor core since 2023.
